name: Snowman (paint)
interestingFacts: Special paint for the "Catch the Snowman" event which was held in the RU community during the New Year 2017-2018 festivities. The paint was issued to RU Helpers of Administration on January 4, 2018, and removed immediately after the event concluded. It was used again for a similar event in 2020, in the EN community.
This paint was available only to helpers of the game during the "Catch the Snowman" event, it was removed once the event finished.
The catch the snowman event was held again in January 2020 and 2021.
